Transport ships of this unidentified class were used at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This class had an elongated body with a bridge section in the bow and outriggers extending from the stern section on both sides.

Among the organizations using this starship class were the [[Dynath Miners]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" />

The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] used those transports as deep space scanners in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="SWG:NS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ships of this unidentified class could be found in all space sectors of [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Most served no purpose and randomly flew around in the game's space zones. A few ships were used during space quests, mostly involving patrols and rescue operations. The class was only identified as "Civilian Transport".
